model.name: Qwen Image 2.1 GGUF Q4_K 7B
model.description: Smallest practical DiT (Q4_K, 4.0 GB). Lightest 2.1 option besides community INT4. Fine-detail and small text take a hit. Encoder + VAE still required (~10 GB extra). License follows Qwen Research License.
model.selector_help: For 8–12 GB cards or when disk is tight. Not the 4090 recommendation — INT8 ConvRot is cleaner and faster on NVIDIA. Q2_K/Q3_K exist upstream but are too lossy to ship here. Default 1024.

resource_requirements.note: Lightest shipped 2.1 DiT. Use INT8 ConvRot on a 4090.
